is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles arabiensis and Anopheles gambiae s.s. (page 2, Materials and Methods).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports genotyping for Vgsc L995F (1014F) and Vgsc L995S (1014S) in Table 1 (page 3).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 1 (page 3) provides genotype counts (LL, LS, SS) and allele frequencies for the 1014 kdr locus in An. arabiensis.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from Dioulassoba, Burkina Faso (page 2, Materials and Methods).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting original field collections and microarray/qPCR experiments.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies the location as Dioulassoba, Bobo-Dioulasso, Burkina Faso (page 2, Materials and Methods).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collections were made in August 2009 and January 2010 (page 2, Materials and Methods).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes new collections and experiments conducted by the authors.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype data is provided in Table 1.

assessment.summary: This study investigates DDT resistance in Anopheles arabiensis from a polluted urban site in Bobo-Dioulasso, Burkina Faso. It reports high DDT resistance and a high frequency of the 1014S kdr mutation, alongside microarray and qPCR analysis of detoxification genes.
